_comment: FUTURE CAPABILITY — not yet referenced by SKILL.md, part of the not-yet-active design mode (see SKILL.md 'Roadmap: design mode'). Design-mode rule priorities. Reflects cost-of-failure WHEN A GAP IS DISCOVERED AT DESIGN TIME. Differences from audit profile are deliberate: design-time gaps in fairness/safety/explainability/privacy are critical (cheap to bake in, expensive to retrofit); some test/release rules are downgraded because they cannot be assessed before code exists. See the 'rationale' block below for per-rule reasoning.

rationale.RAIDD-01: Fairness baked at design - expensive to retrofit
rationale.RAIDD-03: Privacy violations after launch trigger breach notifications
rationale.RAIDD-04: Pre-LLM safety gate must be designed; bolting on post-hoc rarely works
rationale.RAIDD-05: Kill-switch + escalation must be designed in
rationale.RAIER-02: Cannot go/no-go at design - defer to release
rationale.RAIER-04: Traceability artifact emerges at build time
rationale.RAIOP-05: Disclosure copy is design-time; cheap to forget
